指标取值逻辑:
-- 平均招聘天数 = (社招累计招聘天数 + 活水累计招聘天数) / 符合条件的flow_main_id去重数
WITH 
-- ① 社招数据：筛选入职记录，关联岗位发布时间，计算招聘天数
shezhao AS (
  SELECT 
    t2.flow_main_id,
    -- 计算招聘天数 = 入职日期 - 岗位发布日期
    DATEDIFF(
      TO_DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(t2.hire_date / 1000)),
      TO_DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(t1.publish_time / 1000))
    ) AS recruit_days
  FROM catalog_dos_da_mcp.hrdw.Report_Recruit_Flow_Detail t2
  LEFT JOIN catalog_dos_da_mcp.hrdw.Report_Position_Management_Recruitment_P_I_Daily_Slice t1
    ON t2.post_id = t1.recruit_post_id
  WHERE t2.hire_date >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-01-01') * 1000  -- begin_date（默认今年1月1日）
    AND t2.hire_date <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-07') * 1000   -- end_date（默认昨天）
    AND t2.is_entry = '是'
),
-- ② 活水数据：筛选活水入职记录，关联岗位发布时间，计算招聘天数
huoshui AS (
  SELECT 
    t2.flow_main_id,
    -- 计算招聘天数 = 活水入职日期 - 岗位发布日期
    DATEDIFF(
      TO_DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(t2.huoshui_transfer_date / 1000)),
      TO_DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(t1.publish_time / 1000))
    ) AS recruit_days
  FROM catalog_dos_da_mcp.hrdw.Report_Recruit_Flow_Detail t2
  LEFT JOIN catalog_dos_da_mcp.hrdw.Report_Position_Management_Recruitment_P_I_Daily_Slice t1
    ON t2.post_id = t1.recruit_post_id
  WHERE t2.huoshui_transfer_date >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-01-01') * 1000  -- begin_date（默认今年1月1日）
    AND t2.huoshui_transfer_date <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-07') * 1000   -- end_date（默认昨天）
)
-- ③ 计算平均招聘天数
SELECT 
  -- (社招累计招聘天数 + 活水累计招聘天数) / 去重flow_main_id数
  (SELECT SUM(recruit_days) FROM shezhao) + 
  (SELECT SUM(recruit_days) FROM huoshui)
  / 
  NULLIF(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flow_main_id) FROM shezhao) + 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flow_main_id) FROM huoshui), 
    0
  ) 
  AS avg_recruit_days
